examShortTricks: Trick 1: CO is a reducing agent because C goes from +2 to +4: Fe2O3 + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO2 (blast furnace) — the standard equation.
Trick 2: With metals: Ni + 4CO → Ni(CO)4 (Mond's process for nickel purification); with non-metals: CO + Cl2 → COCl2 (phosgene, sunlight).
Trick 3: Toxicity one-liner: CO binds haemoglobin ~200× more strongly than O2, causing oxygen starvation (carboxyhaemoglobin).
